notes: The appositional even before the whole congregation is left added: no object marker or other morpheme stands on that phrase, which is rule 16's limit on that family.
into is placed on the adverbial accusative midbar under rule 33 rather than on the verb, since the noun's own case-function licenses it.
The phrase's single the goes to the assimilated article of ba-chodesh and the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented under rule 47.
